description:
Outcome: The owner can inspect the member booking journey before live integration, from README first-version scope and owner instructions.
Scope: Clearly labelled demo availability for three courts across the whole rolling booking window, own bookings, quota/conflict/cancellation states and timezone labels. Excludes: live booking writes.
Acceptance: Keyboard-usable preview shows free and occupied slots, quota reached, empty bookings and unavailable cancellation without exposing other members' names. Expose every eligible hourly start through the inclusive 168-hour upper bound, even across eight calendar dates.
Behaviour: Accessible labels, focus and error summaries, status feedback and explicit demo data.
Verification: make test template checks and owner inspection. Prerequisites: Individual accounts and Django foundation. Assumptions: Server-rendered Django forms, local clock-hour slots and configurable club timezone initially UTC.
title: Accessible booking-flow preview
